svg.title: Stage 06 End-to-End Convergence: Comparison Operator and Single-Lift Volume Height (LiftVolumeHeight.lean)
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram of the Stage 06 convergence proving New.Data.heightLe_liftDeterminant_ratio inside LiftVolumeHeight.lean. Band 1 shows two Stage 06 solid-border inputs and one Stage 07 dashed typed black box: (1) Gluing Maps and Tight Frame (GluingMaps.lean + exists_tight_frame_formTuples, emerald solid) constructs U_theta = comparisonOp j theta = n_Aut * hk^2 * glue_theta compose glue_theta^* satisfying IsComparisonOperator (integral away from Q, operator norm ||U_1|| <= exp(3A) with A = f m b log^2 b, orthogonal to false lifts); (2) Twisted Hecke L-Value Height (TwistedValueHeights.lean::heightLe_inv_heckeValueProd_div, cobalt solid) combines #A = k/2 main pairs and #B = 5m ramified pairs into HeightLe(10 m x_1 + k(6 denominatorBudget - D.directionAmount)) on rho_{xi_iota^j}^(-1) = Gamma_j(1)/Gamma_j(xi_iota^j); (3) Stage 07 Typed Black Box (IsRegularFamily theta, rust dashed) supplies HasSmallRatios to Input 2 and ClearsProjection within denominatorBudget to Band 2. Band 2 (LiftVolumeHeight.lean) applies IsComparisonOperator.exists_normDet_sq_mul_det_eq, Z_j(theta) * Delta(theta) = C * rho_theta^d with Delta(theta) = det(pr U_theta) and C = det(U^circ) != 0, and divides theta = 1 by theta = xi_iota^j to cancel C identically: Z_j(1)/Z_j(xi_iota^j) = (Delta(xi_iota^j)/Delta(1)) * rho_{xi_iota^j}^(-d). Two distinct intermediate height sub-boxes sit side by side: Left (emerald/amber) bounds Compressed Determinant Ratio Delta(xi_iota^j)/Delta(1) via Archimedean ||sigma(Delta(1))|| <= exp(3 d A) (norm_map_det_liftCompression_le) and p-adic ||iota(Delta(xi_iota^j))|| <= exp(d r beta_ell) (norm_padic_det_liftCompression_le via ClearsProjection) to yield intermediate height d * (3A + r * denominatorBudget); Right (cobalt) raises the inverse Hecke value ratio to the d-th power to yield intermediate height d * (10 m x_1 + k * (6 denominatorBudget - D.directionAmount)). In the transition to Band 3, D.le_of_hasLogBound absorbs all four positive error terms: 3A + r * denominatorBudget + 10 m x_1 + 6 k * denominatorBudget <= k * log b * denominatorBudget. Band 3 presents the main theorem New.Data.heightLe_liftDeterminant_ratio giving HeightLe(d * k * (log b * denominatorBudget - D.directionAmount)) on Z_j(1)/Z_j(theta(iota)^j), with a rust handoff panel into Stage 05 (05_determinant/long_forms, LongForms.lean) where k * log b * denominatorBudget = f a log^4 b / m and summing j = 1..m yields -d * D.mainAmount in Theorem C (integral_forms_long).

Divide ϑ = 1 by ϑ = ξιj (C cancels identically): Zj(1) / Zj(ξιj) = ( Δ(ξιj) / Δ(1) ) · ρξιj−d
Two distinct intermediate height bounds (before log b absorption)
● FACTOR 1 · COMPRESSED DETERMINANT RATIO Δ(ξιj) / Δ(1)
norm_map_det_liftCompression_le (pr norm-nonincreasing, false-lift orth.)
